title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean

translated_title: FlashREINFORCE：面向智能体语言模型的无评论家单次轨迹异步强化学习
translated_abstract: 异步强化学习适用于轨迹生成时间不规则的长程智能体，但基于组间相对优势的更新需要对每个提示词进行多次轨迹采样。然而，基于分组的采样方式在固定轨迹生成预算下限制了提示词的覆盖范围，并引入了组同步屏障。每个提示词仅采样一次虽可避免这些限制，但会失去用于降低方差的组基线，导致更新噪声更大，在过时的、长度不一的轨迹上更容易不稳定。我们提出 FlashREINFORCE，一个无评论家的单次通过框架，其建立在单批次 REINFORCE、序列信赖域和样本均值优化之上。这些组件在保留提示词覆盖范围和带符号反馈的同时，控制了策略漂移和由序列长度放大的负向更新。实验表明，在策略滞后约四次更新的条件下，FlashREINFORCE 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上经过 6,000 次更新仍保持稳定。在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 上，其平均成绩达到 38.0（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 提出 FlashREINFORCE——一种无评论家、每个提示词仅单次采样的异步强化学习框架，通过单批次 REINFORCE、序列信赖域与样本均值优化，在策略滞后约四步的情况下仍能稳定训练智能体语言模型，同时保持提示词覆盖度。
en_tdlr: FlashREINFORCE is a critic-free, single-rollout-per-prompt asynchronous RL framework that leverages One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization to enable stable training of agentic LLMs under a policy lag of about four updates while preserving prompt coverage.
